## About

David Vique is a Senior Full Stack AI Engineer based in Ecuador with 5+ years of experience
building AI-driven SaaS products, web and mobile apps, automation pipelines, voice agents, and cloud systems on AWS and Azure
for US and European clients. End-to-end ownership: frontend, backend, DevOps, and AI integrations.

9+ products shipped. Springer BICA 2023 paper (Vol. 1130). Triathlon finisher (1.5 km swim · 40 km bike · 10 km run).

## Selected Projects

- **Opal Group Meetings** — Built from scratch: web app (Next.js + NestJS + PostgreSQL) plus iOS and Android apps (React Native) for one-on-one meetings at executive conferences. Azure + CI/CD pipelines, Salesforce and MeetMax integrations, product design and branding.
- **UMI** — AI meeting intelligence (Meet, Zoom, Teams). Whisper transcription, RAG chat, mem0 memory, NestJS, Next.js, AWS Lambda.
- **CT** — Commission Tracker for 50+ companies. Two-step dynamic prompt architecture, OCR, queue-based serverless processing.
- **BMC** — React 19 SPA on S3+CloudFront. Streaming AI chat, Lambda form handlers, full SEO stack.
- **Relatividad IA** — Logistic Tracker SaaS + WhatsApp CRM + AI voice agents (ElevenLabs + Twilio + Retell AI + GHL).
- **Entropía N8N Studio** — AI automation agency. N8N agentic flows, GHL embedded apps, voice agents, WhatsApp funnels.
- **Shooting Range Simulator** — Unity 3D + Kinect 2 + OpenCV. Published Springer BICA 2023.
